description: The definitions the architecture writer, review and conformance results share: coverage rows, evidence references, business conflicts, coverage checks, the review verdict and conformance findings. Defined only here; every other schema reaches them with a $ref to architecture-common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

EvidenceRef.description: One piece of evidence. Every field is present; a field the reference does not use is the empty string.

BusinessConflict.description: Two or more business requirements of the PRD that no design can satisfy together, and why.

CoverageStatus.description: How far the architecture covers one obligation. A consumer reads an invalid value as the default.

CoverageAction.description: What the change does to the views covering one obligation. A consumer reads an invalid value as the default.

CoverageDisposition.description: Whether a coverage row is required by this change or unrelated historical debt. A consumer reads an invalid value as the default.

CoverageRow.description: One obligation of the architecture documentation model and how the architecture covers it.

ReviewVerdict.description: A reviewer's verdict on one claim or one coverage row.

CoverageCheck.description: A reviewer's independent check of one coverage row, by its id.

ConformanceFinding.description: One problem the conformance reviewer found, with its file and evidence.
